about: A fixed set of short documents and questions for measuring knowledge search. 'paraphrase' questions share almost no words with their answer; 'exact' questions reuse its wording; 'identifier' questions ask for a code, name or number; 'unanswerable' questions have no answer in the set and should return nothing.

documents.title: Connecting to the office network from home
documents.text: To reach internal systems from outside the building, start the WireGuard client and pick the profile named HQ-Staff. The tunnel drops after eight hours and has to be started again. If the handshake fails, check that your laptop clock is correct.

documents.title: Account lockouts
documents.text: After five wrong attempts your sign-in is frozen for fifteen minutes. To get back in sooner, open the self-service portal, choose 'I cannot sign in' and confirm with the code sent to your phone. The helpdesk can also unlock it during working hours.

documents.title: Claiming travel costs
documents.text: Submit receipts within thirty days of the trip using form F-204. Meals are refunded up to 45 euros per day. Taxi fares need a note explaining why public transport was not possible. Refunds arrive with the next salary run.

documents.title: Third floor printer
documents.text: The Kyocera on the third floor jams when the paper tray is filled above the line. Error C7990 means the waste toner box is full; a spare is in the cupboard under the machine. Hold the green button for three seconds to restart it.

documents.title: Cold brew recipe
documents.text: Coarsely grind 100 grams of beans and steep them in one litre of cold water for sixteen hours in the fridge. Strain through a paper filter. The concentrate keeps for a week and is diluted one to one before drinking.

documents.title: Sourdough schedule
documents.text: Feed the starter at eight in the evening. Mix the dough the next morning, fold it four times during the day and shape it in the evening. Bake in a preheated cast-iron pot at 240 degrees for forty minutes, the first twenty with the lid on.

documents.title: Fixing a flat tyre
documents.text: Remove the wheel, lever one side of the tyre off the rim and pull out the inner tube. Find the hole by inflating the tube and listening, roughen the area, apply glue, wait until it is tacky and press the patch on firmly. Check the inside of the tyre for the thorn before refitting.

documents.title: Self-employed tax deadlines
documents.text: Advance payments are due on the tenth of March, June, September and December. The yearly declaration must be filed by the thirty-first of July. Keep invoices for ten years. Late filing costs a surcharge of a quarter percent per month.

documents.title: Database backup routine
documents.text: The reporting database is dumped every night at 02:00 to the NAS and copied to off-site storage on Sundays. Dumps older than thirty days are deleted. A restore test is run on the first Monday of each month; error 3154 during a restore means the dump belongs to another database.

documents.title: Release checklist
documents.text: Merge only when the pipeline is green. Tag the commit, wait for the staging rollout to finish and run the smoke tests. Production goes out on Tuesdays and Thursdays before noon. If the error rate rises above two percent, roll back with the previous tag.

documents.title: On-call rotation
documents.text: Each engineer carries the pager for one week, starting Monday at ten. Alerts must be acknowledged within ten minutes. If you cannot respond, hand the shift to your backup in the scheduling tool. Night call-outs are compensated with time off the next day.

documents.title: Runtime constraint for the billing service
documents.text: The billing service has to stay on Python 3.9 because the payment provider's signed library is not built for newer interpreters. Do not use match statements or the newer union type syntax there. Revisit when the vendor ships version 5 of its library.

documents.title: Rotating API credentials
documents.text: Service tokens expire after ninety days. Generate the replacement in the admin console, store it in the secrets vault under the same name with a new version, restart the consumers and revoke the old token only after a day without errors.

documents.title: Tomato notes
documents.text: Sow indoors in late February and move the plants outside after the last frost in mid May. Pinch out side shoots weekly. Water at the base in the morning; wet leaves invite blight. The San Marzano row gave the best crop last summer.

documents.title: Sleep advice from the clinic
documents.text: Keep the same wake-up time every day, including weekends. Avoid caffeine after two in the afternoon and screens in the last hour before bed. If you lie awake for more than twenty minutes, get up and read in dim light until you feel drowsy.

documents.title: Treating a minor burn
documents.text: Hold the area under cool running water for twenty minutes. Do not use ice or butter. Cover loosely with cling film or a sterile non-fluffy dressing. See a doctor if the burn is larger than the person's hand, blistered on the face, or caused by chemicals.

documents.title: Apartment lease terms
documents.text: The rent of 1,180 euros is due on the third working day of the month. Notice to leave is three months in writing. The landlord, Ms Okafor, must be told about pets in advance. The deposit of two months' rent is returned within six weeks of moving out.

documents.title: Car service history
documents.text: Oil and filter changed at 82,400 km in April. Front brake pads replaced at 76,000 km. The timing belt is due at 120,000 km. Tyre pressure should be 2.4 bar front and 2.2 rear. The next inspection is due in October.

documents.title: Home router setup
documents.text: The router's admin page is at 192.168.50.1. Guests use the separate network 'Maple-Guest', which cannot see the printer or the NAS. Channel 36 works best upstairs. Firmware updates are installed manually on the first weekend of the month.

documents.title: Planning meeting, 12 November
documents.text: We agreed to postpone the mobile redesign until the search rewrite ships. Priya owns the migration plan and will present it on the 26th. The budget for contractors is capped at 18,000 euros this quarter. Marco raised a risk about the analytics vendor contract ending in January.

documents.title: First week for new colleagues
documents.text: On day one you receive a laptop and a badge at reception. Complete the security training by Friday. Your buddy introduces you to the team rituals: stand-up at half past nine and the demo every second Thursday. Ask for repository access in the #access channel.

documents.title: Handling a data deletion request
documents.text: When a customer asks for their personal data to be erased, log the request in the privacy register the same day. Identity must be verified first. Erasure covers the CRM, the mailing lists and support tickets and has to be completed within one month; invoices are kept for the legal retention period.

documents.title: Sending invoices
documents.text: Invoices are numbered INV-year-sequence and sent as PDF on the last working day of the month. Payment terms are fourteen days. A reminder goes out after twenty-one days and a second one with a late fee of forty euros after thirty-five.

documents.title: Night sky photography settings
documents.text: Use a tripod, the widest aperture and manual focus set on a bright star. Start with ISO 3200 and a twenty-second exposure; longer than that and the stars become streaks at 24 mm. Shoot in RAW and switch off image stabilisation.

documents.title: Practice plan
documents.text: Twenty minutes of scales with a metronome at 72, then the left hand of the Chopin nocturne alone, slowly. Record the last run-through each Sunday. The teacher wants bars 17 to 24 memorised before the next lesson.

documents.title: Training block for the spring race
documents.text: Four runs a week: one long, one tempo, two easy. The long run grows by two kilometres each week up to thirty-two, then tapers for three weeks. Take a gel every forty minutes on anything over ninety minutes. Rest completely the day after the long run.

documents.title: Vet instructions for Bruno
documents.text: Give half a tablet of the anti-inflammatory with food twice a day for ten days. No stairs or jumping for two weeks. The stitches come out on the fourteenth. Call the practice if the wound is hot, swollen or oozing.

documents.title: Lisbon trip bookings
documents.text: Outbound flight TP573 leaves at 07:25 on the 4th of March; return TP578 on the 9th at 18:10. The hotel, Casa do Bairro, is booked under reference LX-88217 and includes breakfast. Airport transfer is not included.

documents.title: Why the orders query was slow
documents.text: The report scanned the whole orders table because the filter wrapped the date column in a function, which stopped the index from being used. Rewriting the condition as a range on the raw column cut the run time from forty seconds to under one.

documents.title: Logging conventions
documents.text: Log in structured JSON with a request id on every line. Never log passwords, tokens or full card numbers. Use the warning level for things a person should look at tomorrow and the error level for things that need attention now.

documents.title: Boiler pressure
documents.text: If the radiators stay cold and the gauge reads below one bar, open the filling loop under the boiler until the needle reaches 1.5, then close both taps. Bleed the upstairs radiators afterwards with the square key kept in the meter cupboard.

documents.title: Household contents policy
documents.text: Policy number HC-4471902 with Nordlicht covers theft, fire and water damage up to 60,000 euros. Bicycles are insured only when locked. The excess is 250 euros per claim. Report a loss within seven days by phone or through the customer portal.

documents.title: Verb tenses to revise
documents.text: The preterite is for completed actions and the imperfect for background and habits. Irregular preterites to drill: tener, estar, poder, poner, saber. The subjunctive follows expressions of doubt, wish and emotion.

documents.title: School pick-up arrangements
documents.text: Lena finishes at 15:15 on Mondays and Wednesdays and at 13:00 on Fridays. Swimming is on Tuesday at 16:30; the bag with towel and goggles hangs by the door. Grandpa collects her on Thursdays.

documents.title: Review guidelines
documents.text: Keep changes under four hundred lines. Describe why, not only what. Reviewers respond within one working day. Approve when the change improves the code even if it is not perfect; block only for bugs, security problems or missing tests.

documents.title: Roof panels output
documents.text: The array of twelve panels peaks at 4.6 kilowatts around one in the afternoon in June. In December the daily yield falls to about three kilowatt-hours. The inverter shows fault 301 when the grid voltage is too high; it clears by itself.
